description: Inspect an overlay before configuring it: its editable fields with types, allowed values, limits and default values, looks, aspects, duration, whether its default is free, and its published examples (id, name, niche, free). fixed lists the design values this overlay sets and never lets a configuration change; for a different design choose another overlay. Each field has relevant (the default uses it now) and showWhen (the conditions under which it is used; absent means always). cues lists the taps the overlay declares (id, kind, at in overlay seconds, when) for sound placement; most overlays declare none.

overlay.description: An overlay id returned by list_overlays.

name: get_overlay
